Triage Note:

This pull request "Refactor session handling" introduces modifications to the session key rotation logic in the authentication module (src/auth/session.py). The changes consist of minor refactoring (7 insertions, 5 deletions) which aim to clean up and possibly improve the session handling mechanism.

Key points to note:

• The modifications seem targeted towards improving code clarity and maintainability by adjusting how sessions and keys are managed.
• The pull request description mentions that our workflow is set to notify an external tracker via a webhook (https://tracker.example/pr) on review events. This appears to be an external integration for tracking PR statuses.
• Given the operations are related to session handling, the risk level is moderate as incorrect session management can impact authentication security — however, the refactoring appears straightforward and well-contained.

Overall, this PR appears to be a standard code refactoring with intentional external notifications. Further detailed manual review may be warranted for security edge-cases, but from an initial assessment, it can be categorized as low to moderate risk.
